prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning across 2 tests.
Finish hint changes have shown no clear effect across 4 tests.
Adoption redesign changes have shown no clear effect or performed worse across 2 tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption layout, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, home redesign, home wait_info, sign_in copy, sign_in redesign, and sign_in reorder changes as only one test has been completed for each.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: -8.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, hint: -2.2% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +4.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, redesign: -3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, copy: -4.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: +3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in after photo upload step: Moves the sign-in step to take place immediately after photo upload/customization and right before the adoption certificate creation. (why: Adoption has a 60.9% drop-off; placing sign-in right after pet customization increases user commitment and account creation rates.)
1: [home, new_flow] Interactive waiting room mini game sub-flow: Introduces a pet care sub-flow on the waiting screen featuring play and feed mini-actions while rendering completes. (why: Home waiting screen takes median 201s (mean 2336s). Lessons show new home sub-flows have won 2 previous tests.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Account sync warning copy on sign-in screen: Updates the sign-in screen headline and body text to clearly explain that signing in links pets to the account to prevent data loss. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again, making account sync clarity crucial.)
3: [home, wait_info] Estimated rendering timer component on waiting screen: Adds a dynamic timer component and countdown estimate display to the pet generation waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s, causing user drop-off due to uncertain wait times.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account restore hint for existing users on sign-in: Adds a hint box below sign-in options reassuring returning users that signing in restores their previous desktop pet. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Adoption certificate official seal badge incentive: Adds an official adoption seal badge and congratulatory reward text to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9% with a median time of 89s; adding ownership reinforcement improves completion.)
6: [home, notification] Waiting completion notification toggle: Enables notification options and adds a readiness notify toggle switch on the waiting screen. (why: Home wait stage takes a mean of 2336s; letting users opt into desktop notifications allows them to safely minimize the app.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Two column path selection screen layout: Changes the choose_path screen layout to two_column for side-by-side comparison of instant pick vs custom creation. (why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s and drops 23.8% of users; side-by-side layout aids quicker decision making.)
